title: Lesson 1 Quiz: The DeFi Risk Map

questions.text: What is oracle risk in Decentralized Finance?
options: A coding error in a smart contract that lets hackers drain funds.
Inaccurate price feed data that misvalues assets or causes unfair liquidations.
Whale wallet holders voting to drain protocol treasuries.
Cross-chain bridge contracts being exploited during token transfers.
questions.explanation: Oracle risk occurs when inaccurate price feed data tricks a protocol into misvaluing assets or triggering unfair liquidations.

questions.text: True or false: Unlike traditional finance, DeFi protocols do not offer bank-backed deposit insurance or regulatory safety nets.
questions.explanation: In DeFi, you act as your own risk manager because traditional bank insurance and regulatory oversight do not exist to protect deposits.
